name: create_nestjs_items_controller
description: Creates a NestJS controller for an in-memory items resource
prompts: Write a NestJS application in main.ts (a tsconfig.json with the right compiler options for decorators is already provided - do not change it) implementing an in-memory items resource with an ItemsController mapped to the /items route. Implement: GET /items returns 200 with a JSON array of all items; POST /items accepts JSON body {"name": string} and returns 201 with the created item {id, name} (id is a number, auto-incrementing starting at 1); GET /items/:id returns 200 with the item if found, or throws a NotFoundException (404) if not found. Bootstrap the app with NestFactory and listen on port 8021. The app must be runnable directly with `ts-node main.ts` (no separate build step, no package.json).

test_setup_files.test_items.py:
import subprocess, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8021{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

srv = subprocess.Popen(['ts-node', 'main.ts'])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/items')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, f'server never became reachable on :8021 (last: {status} {body!r})'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'widget'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201, got {status} {body!r}'
    assert body['name'] == 'widget' and isinstance(body['id'], int)
    iid = body['id']

    status, body = req('GET', f'/items/{iid}')
    assert status == 200 and body['name'] == 'widget'

    status, body = req('GET', '/items/999999')
    assert status == 404, f'expected 404 for missing item, got {status}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/items')
    assert status == 200 and len(body) == 1
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
